metric_policy.complete_package_note: Complete package includes generated MBIST wrappers, algorithms, saboteur/model RTL, and staged SRAM behavioral models.
metric_policy.storage_note: Unpacked behavioral memory arrays are reported as memory_bit_count, not flipflop_count.

registers.name: CTRL_ENABLE
registers.description: Global enable for request acceptance and active supervision.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: When 1, request acceptance and supervisory operation are enabled. When 0, new command acceptance is blocked and the design remains in safe fallback behavior.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: CTRL_FALLBACK_SELECT
registers.description: Selects the conservative fallback mode used when safe fallback is active.

fields.name: FALLBACK_SELECT
fields.description: Fallback mode selector. Encodes a small set of deterministic conservative poses/commands.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: CTRL_TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD
registers.description: Timeout window in cycles for an outstanding request.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD
fields.description: Maximum allowed outstanding request age before timeout fault. Value 0 is illegal for normal operation and forces unsafe configuration handling if written.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: CMD_MIN
fields.description: Lower clamp bound for validated and fallback actuator commands.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: CMD_MAX
fields.description: Upper clamp bound for validated and fallback actuator commands.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: CTRL_FALLBACK_VALUE
registers.description: Host-programmed conservative fallback command within configured bounds.

fields.name: FALLBACK_VALUE
fields.description: Conservative actuator command used in safe fallback if selected and within bounds. If out of bounds, the supervisor clamps or flags configuration fault per safety policy.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: FSM_STATE
fields.description: Current FSM encoding: 0=RESET, 1=IDLE, 2=ISSUE_REQUEST, 3=WAIT_RESPONSE, 4=APPLY_VALIDATED_COMMAND, 5=SAFE_FALLBACK, 6=FAULT_HOLD. Other encodings reserved.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: OUTSTANDING_SEQ
fields.description: Sequence tag for the currently outstanding request. Zero indicates none or reset baseline depending on state.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: LAST_FAULT_REASON
fields.description: Fault reason encoding. Example meanings: 0=none, 1=timeout, 2=stale response, 3=sequence mismatch, 4=range violation, 5=illegal configuration, 6=invalid actuator command, 7=protocol mismatch, others reserved.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: STATUS_SAFE_FALLBACK_ACTIVE
registers.description: Indicates whether safe fallback is active.

fields.name: SAFE_FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: 1 when conservative fallback behavior is active; 0 when a validated command is being presented under normal supervision.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: FAULT_STICKY
fields.description: Sticky fault summary. Bits latch until reset or explicit clear. Suggested bit mapping: bit0 timeout/stale, bit1 sequence mismatch, bit2 range violation, bit3 illegal configuration, bit4 invalid actuator command, bit5 protocol mismatch, bit6 reserved, bit7 reserved.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: FAULT_CLEAR
fields.description: Write 1 to clear sticky fault bits. The clear action is synchronous and pulse-like; write 0 has no effect.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.
